newsitem.title: MEXICO: Dina says Q1 net rises. [CORRECTED 01:29 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Dina says Q1 net rises. [CORRECTED 01:29 GMT]

text.p: (Company corrects to show that profit rose rather than fell.)
A highly-placed source at Mexican Consorcio G Grupo Dina told Reuters late Monday that it erred on its earnings media statement and that its net profit actually rose sharply.

He said the truck manufacturer's net profit rose to 49.50 million pesos in the first three months of the year compared with 74,000 pesos in the year-ago period. In its earlier statement the company had misstated its net profit for the first quarter of 1996 as 75 million pesos.
The source declined to be identified.
